title: persona.json (persona-interchange-format 0.4)
description: persona.json: one person, everything about them, at the root of a persona package (a .persona.zip holding, beside it, every file it names in pictures/, audio/, avatars/). Each field below is written as the values it may take, then "—", then what it means; $values explains how values are written. A list shows one entry, standing for every entry. Keys beginning with $ are notes, never part of persona.json. Every field is written; their order does not matter. A reader ignores any field it does not know, and reads a value it does not know as $values says; specVersion changes whenever a field or a value is added, or one changes meaning. Nothing in the file belongs to any one app: an app keeps its own data about a persona (how it lays people out, what it has built from the photos, its settings) apart from it. A persona's life is told on a timeline: profiles (who they were), slices (the chapters of their life), health periods and events, and the people, places, schools, property, pets and jobs with periods of their own. A null end date means ongoing; for someone deceased, it runs until their death. Any date may be only roughly remembered: beside each date is a field named for it with Approximate added (startDateApproximate beside startDate) that says so, and the date is then the best guess at the day. The people reach as far back as a family tree does: anyone may be born from 1000-01-01 on, someone known to have died on a day nobody recorded is deceased with no deathDate, and the pronouns each went by are on their periods.

specVersion.description: the version of the format the file follows

id.description: this persona's own id; a person in another persona's file stands for this persona by naming it as their personaId

birthDate.description: the day the persona was born, 1000-01-01 or later

birthDateApproximate.description: true when the birth date is only approximate, a best guess by someone who does not remember the day; false when it is known

deathDate.description: the day the persona died; null while living, and for a persona who died on a day nobody recorded (deceased)

deathDateApproximate.description: true when the death date is only approximate, a best guess by someone who does not remember the day; false when it is known, and while it is null

deceased.description: whether the persona has died: true when they have died, with or without a deathDate; false while living. A persona deceased with no deathDate is taken to have lived to 80, or to the latest end date of their profiles, slices and health periods if that is later (a null end date runs until the death, so does not count)

educationLevel.description: the schooling the persona finished: hs_not_completed (left before finishing high school), hs_completed, or post_1 to post_10 (years of study after high school: post_4 is a four-year degree); null until known

writingProficiency.description: how well the persona writes, which is how they write in a conversation; none when they do not communicate at all, so cannot be talked to; null until known

genderIdentity.description: the persona's gender; how they presented it, and their pronouns, are on each profile; nonbinary for one the reader does not know

country.description: the country the persona is from (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); null until known

culturalBackground.description: the culture the persona grew up in; null until known

attentiveness.description: focus on the task and its details: high stays on them and makes fewer mistakes, but is slower; low is quicker but less focused, and slips more; null until set

extraversion.description: openness with inner thoughts: high shares them, and readily connects them to other people; low keeps them close; null until set

agreeableness.description: willingness to go along: high avoids arguments, agrees where it has no set view, and keeps quiet rather than lie; low argues readily, and will lie where the persona would; null until set

neuroticism.description: anxiety: high is anxious and guarded, and quick to see risk in what is asked; low is calm and open, and little worried about what could go wrong; null until set

ambition.description: drive: high is curious about ideas with potential, even ones it disagrees with, and self-directed; low accepts the status quo, and leans on others; null until set

emotionality.description: how the persona thinks and speaks: high through feeling, low through logic; null until set

tendencies.description: The persona's core tendencies, each on a scale of 0 to 100. Profiles and slices may change them for a while (tendencyOverrides).

core.description: What holds across the whole life.

startDate.description: the first day of this profile

startDateApproximate.description: true when the first day is only approximate, a best guess by someone who does not remember the day; false when it is known

endDate.description: the last day of this profile; null while it goes on

endDateApproximate.description: true when the last day is only approximate, a best guess by someone who does not remember the day; false when it is known, and while it goes on

transitionBefore.description: the change that led into this profile: a graduation, coming out, a diagnosis, and the questioning or upheaval around it; empty when there was none

label.description: what the profile is called on the timeline ("As Michael", "After the move")

primaryName.description: the persona's full name during this profile

description.description: who the persona was during this profile

tendencyOverrides.description: The core tendencies this profile changes, each replacing the core value while it lasts; an axis it leaves alone is left out.

genderPresentation.description: how the persona presented: as a man, a woman, or a gender non-conforming man (gnc_man) or woman (gnc_woman); for one the reader does not know, gnc_woman if the persona is a woman and gnc_man otherwise

pronouns.description: the pronouns the persona went by; any for any pronouns, name_only for none (the name instead); name_only for one the reader does not know

items.description: a language the persona spoke: its ISO 639-1 code, or its ISO 639-3 code where it has no two-letter one (yue is Cantonese, hmn Hmong, ase American Sign Language); at least one

languages.description: a language the persona spoke: its ISO 639-1 code, or its ISO 639-3 code where it has no two-letter one (yue is Cantonese, hmn Hmong, ase American Sign Language); at least one

primaryLanguage.description: the language the persona spoke by default; one of languages. For one the reader does not know, the first of languages it does know, or en if it knows none of them (which it then takes them to speak)

accent.description: the regional accent the persona spoke with, none for no particular one; none for one the reader does not know. An accent's id begins with the code of the country it is from (us_new_england), which need not be where the persona is from

sexualOrientation.description: whom the persona was attracted to: men, women, or both; demi_ only once emotionally bonded (demisexual); asexual for neither; unspecified when not known (as for most ancestors)

romanticOrientation.description: whether the persona fell in love: romantic, only once bonded (demiromantic), or not (aromantic); unspecified when not known

politicalOrientation.description: the persona's politics; unspecified when not said

religion.description: the persona's faith; none (not religious), agnostic, atheist or spiritual (but not religious) for no faith; a branch of a faith where it is known (catholic, sunni, reform_jewish); unspecified when not said
